
```jsx
import { CxListGroup } from '@chassis-ui/react'
// or
import CxListGroup from '@chassis-ui/react/src/react/src/components/list-group/CxListGroup'
```

| Property | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **className** | A string of all className you want applied to the component. | `string` \| `undefined` | - |
| **component** | Component used for the root node. Either a string to use a HTML element or a component. | `string` \| `ComponentClass<any, any>` \| `FunctionComponent<any>` \| `undefined` | ul |
| **flush** | Remove some borders and rounded corners to render list group items edge-to-edge in a parent component (e.g., `<CxCard>`). | `boolean` \| `undefined` | - |
| **layout** | Specify a layout type. | `'horizontal'` \| `'horizontal-small'` \| `'horizontal-medium'` \| `'horizontal-large'` \| `'horizontal-xlarge'` \| `'horizontal-2xlarge'` \| `undefined` | - |
